list.name: hero_display
list.query: WITH cur AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.online, s.game, s.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND s.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND NOT s.derived ORDER BY s.donation_total DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT st.display FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)

list.name: hero_login
list.query: WITH cur AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.online, s.game, s.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND s.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND NOT s.derived ORDER BY s.donation_total DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT st.login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)

list.name: hero_avatar
list.query: WITH cur AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.online, s.game, s.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND s.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND NOT s.derived ORDER BY s.donation_total DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT coalesce(st.profile_url, '') FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)

list.name: hero_location
list.query: WITH cur AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.online, s.game, s.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND s.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND NOT s.derived ORDER BY s.donation_total DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE st.location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place au ZEVENT' WHEN 'Online' THEN 'En stream à distance' ELSE '' END FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)

list.name: hero_status
list.query: WITH cur AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.online, s.game, s.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND s.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND NOT s.derived ORDER BY s.donation_total DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN cur.online THEN 'LIVE' ELSE 'HORS LIGNE' END FROM cur

list.name: hero_color
list.query: WITH cur AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.online, s.game, s.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND s.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND NOT s.derived ORDER BY s.donation_total DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN cur.online THEN '#3fb950' ELSE '#8b949e' END FROM cur

list.name: hero_game
list.query: WITH cur AS (SELECT s.twitch_id, s.online, s.game, s.viewers FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND s.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND NOT s.derived ORDER BY s.donation_total DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN cur.online THEN coalesce(cur.game, '') ELSE '' END FROM cur

Chaque relevé en live compte la minute écoulée depuis le relevé précédent (plafonnée à 5 minutes, pour que les trous dans les données ne comptent pas).

panels.title: Viewer-heures

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)), 0) / 3600.0 FROM streamer_sample_v x JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND x.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND true AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL

panels.description: La taille de l'audience dans le temps, en viewer-heures : le nombre de viewers des streamers correspondant aux filtres Lieu et Streamer, additionné minute par minute sur la période sélectionnée (chaque relevé compte le temps écoulé depuis le précédent, plafonné à 5 minutes pour que les trous dans les données ne comptent pas). Un viewer qui regarde pendant une heure vaut une viewer-heure ; 1 000 viewers pendant 2 heures font 2 000 viewer-heures.

panels.title: Dans cet état depuis

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, ts, online, game FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND NOT derived  ORDER BY donation_total DESC LIMIT 1), changed AS (  SELECT max(s.ts) AS at FROM cur c JOIN streamer_sample_v s USING (twitch_id)  WHERE s.online <> c.online OR s.game IS DISTINCT FROM c.game) SELECT extract(epoch FROM c.ts - coalesce(ch.at, (SELECT first_seen FROM streamer_v st WHERE st.twitch_id = c.twitch_id))) FROM cur c, changed ch

panels.description: Depuis combien de temps le streamer affiché est dans son état actuel (live ou hors ligne) avec le jeu actuel.

panels.title: Dons par viewer-heure

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(s.gain) AS gained FROM streamer_sample_v s  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) , v AS (  SELECT sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0 AS viewer_hours  FROM streamer_sample_v x JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND x.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND true AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL) SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(g.gained), 0) FROM g JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)         WHERE NOT st.derived AND g.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring}) AND true) / nullif(v.viewer_hours, 0) FROM v

panels.description: Ce que la communauté donne par rapport à sa taille : les dons gagnés par les streamers correspondant aux filtres Lieu et Streamer sur la période sélectionnée, divisés par leurs viewer-heures (le nombre de viewers additionné minute par minute sur la même période, en heures). Un viewer qui regarde pendant une heure vaut une viewer-heure : 5 € signifie 5 € récoltés pour chaque heure regardée par un viewer. Les dons sans streamer (billets, boutique, anonymes) ne sont pas comptés.

panels.title: Jeux joués

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT s.ts, s.twitch_id, st.display, CASE WHEN s.online THEN coalesce(s.game, '(sans jeu)') END AS state
  FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND true AND s.twitch_id IN (${streamer:sqlstring})
), d AS (
  SELECT *, lag(state) OVER w AS prev, lead(ts) OVER w AS next,
         min(ts) FILTER (WHERE state IS NOT NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY twitch_id) AS first_live
  FROM s WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY twitch_id ORDER BY ts)
), r AS (
  SELECT ts, display, state, first_live FROM d WHERE state IS DISTINCT FROM prev OR next IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT max(ts) + interval '1 minute', display, NULL, min(first_live) FROM d GROUP BY twitch_id, display
)
SELECT ts AS time, display AS "Streamer", state AS "État", first_live
FROM r ORDER BY first_live NULLS LAST, lower(display), ts
